responsibility: Manages the product catalog including animal categories, products, items, item details and keyword-based product search. Serves catalog browsing and navigation. Backed by the CatalogService and category/product/item domain and mappers.

Handles customer registration, authentication, session lifecycle (login/logout), profile editing, preferred language, favorite category and personalization preferences (personalized product list and promotional banner). Backed by the AccountService and Account domain.

Manages the shopping cart: adding items, consolidating duplicate items, updating quantities, removing items, subtotal calculation and reporting item stock availability at inclusion time. Backed by Cart and CartItem domain logic.

Handles the purchase checkout process, order composition from cart, billing and delivery data, payment details, order confirmation, unique order numbering, order persistence, order history inquiry and access restriction to the owning customer. Also coordinates stock write-off on order completion. Backed by the OrderService and Order/LineItem domain.
